🛤️ Founder's Mindset

Paved My Own Driveway

Complete asphalt paving and paver integration — never hired when I could learn it myself first.

Before hiring anyone, I always ask: "Can I learn this?" Paving a full driveway with complete asphalt and paver integration was one of those challenges I took on myself — saving money and gaining skills.

This same mindset drives my technical work: I learn the hard thing first, then build on it. Whether it's a new ML framework, a hardware repair, or asphalt — ground truth matters.

🎨 Home Renovation

Deck Renovation — 3× Repainted

Painted and refinished the deck hands-on, from start to finish — Red, White, then Grey.

The deck has been repainted 3 times — Red, White, and Grey — each time refining the process, the technique, and the result. Never the same twice; always better.

Like data science work: the first model is rarely the best. Iteration, refinement, and hands-on learning make the difference.
